title: Ops pocket manifest — evening run
content:
Evening pocket-run notes (short, action-first).

Context: quick personal checklist for the 5pm -> 9pm shift. Focus: reclaiming idle GPUs, checking burst pool, watching for egress spikes after the A/B rollout.

Top of mind goals:
- Keep tail latency under 120ms for hosted-low tier (SLO check at 5m).
- Free at least 4 idle GPUs from pool-eta by 7pm (prepare for batch job on 02/Mar).
- Validate fallback routing is enabled for eu-west if us-west capacity steps down.

Immediate checks (order matters):
1) Capacity snapshot (5m) — quick commands:
   - kubectl get nodes -l pool=gp-upool -o wide  # scan GPU node readiness
   - kubectl top nodes | grep nvidia  # rough CPU/GPU pressure
   - nvidia-smi -L  # ensure GPUs appear healthy
   ETA: 5–8m

2) Idle GPU candidates (automation + manual)
   - Query metric: gpu.utilization < 5% & last_active > 2h (promql: avg_over_time(gpu_util[2h]) < 0.05)
   - For pods flagged, check label: "job-type". Prefer evicting batch/test jobs before dedicated inference.
   - Soft-evict plan: cordon -> drain with pod disruption budget awareness -> monitor csds for requeues.
   ETA per node: 8–12m

3) Burst pool sanity (burst-policy v2)
   - Check autoscaler events: kubectl -n infra get hpa burst-pool -o yaml | grep -i events
   - Confirm fallback model routing is active: curl -sS https://console.internal/api/routing/status | jq '.fallback_enabled'
   Quick note: if fallback_enabled == false, set policy to allow-model-variant-fallback (small patch in PR#1423).

4) Network/egress spot-checks
   - Look for sudden increase in egress to model-hosting endpoints (promql: sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/gen"}[1m])))
   - If egress > 400rps and 95p latency > 200ms: open paging channel, start routing to eu-west as fallback by flipping routing weight to 25%.
   ETA: 3–5m to assess, 5–10m to shift routing carefully.

Quick runbook snippets (for immediate copy/paste):
- Cordon + drain node with low-IO:
  kubectl cordon NODE_NAME && kubectl drain NODE_NAME --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120

- Restart gpu-exporter if metrics stale:
  kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/gpu-metrics-exporter

- Force a model-fallback toggler (temporary):
  curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROBOT' https://console.internal/api/routing/weights -d '{"route":"/v1/gen","weights":{"primary":"redwood-7b","fallback":"redwood-3b"}}'
  (note: use --dry-run first in staging)

Open TODOs for tonight (priority marked):
- [P0] Evict 4 idle nodes from pool-eta and confirm freed GPUs in inventory (INFRA-4821). ETA 60–90m.
- [P1] Patch burst autoscaler to ignore short-lived spike sources (small change in HPA controller) (GPUOPS-77). Assign: Noah, tag PR.
- [P2] Validate network egress billing anomaly from 02/Mar 02:00–04:00 (report to finance if >$2k). Owner: Aisha.
- [P3] Draft quick blurb for #infra-shift: "Evening ops: freeing 4 gpus, watching egress; ping me if you have pinned workloads".

Notes to self / gotchas:
- When draining, watch for on-call alerts from model-queue. If queue length spikes > 200, stop draining and roll back.
- Some preemptible batch runners mislabel as "interactive-test" — filter with both labels.
- If a node's nvidia-smi shows ECC errors > 0, tag it and open HW ticket (rack-ops).

Small experiments to try (later this week):
- Try turning on prefix KV caching for redwood-3b on dev (small perf bump, might reduce token cost by ~8%).
- Test a softer drain policy where long-running sessions get migrated to local cache before eviction.

Handoff blurb for next shift (copy into Slack):
  "Left: freed 2/4 target GPUs (nodes x3,x7); burst autoscaler still noisy — PR#1423 open (noah) to filter short spikes. Watch hosted-low SLO; if p95 > 130ms, route 20% to eu-west. Ping me if you need context. — Aisha"

Random scratch (brain dump):
- Need to update personal snippet for quick promql checks and save to snippets library.
- Follow up with Meera about capacity commit for Dedicated — might need to reserve extra 8 GPUs for enterprise test next month.

End of pocket manifest. Keep it short, actionable. Revisit tomorrow morning for followups.
